Date : 22.05.2023 Heard Mr. AM Ahmed, learned counsel for the accused petitioner as well as Mr.
Bankim Sarma, learned Addl. P.P., Assam for the State respondent.

By this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioner, namely, Akbar Ali has prayed for grant of bail in connection with Rupohihat PS Case No.148/2023 under Sections 420/379/34 of IPC r/w Section 51 of the Wild Life (Protection) Act.

The FIR reveals the allegation that during a search operation, one Rhino horn was recovered Page No.# 2/2 from the possession of one Md. Zakir Husain who stated that he was carrying the Rhino Akbar Ali vs The State Of Assam on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90240779/
1 horn along with the present accused petitioner along with two other persons for selling the same to some other persons.

sentences.text: It is noticed that the accused petitioner has been in judicial custody for 60 days since he was arrested on 23.03.2023.
A bail objection has been filed by the investigating officer.

Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the FIR, Forwarding report and the annexure annexed with the bail petition, it is seen that the seized rhino horn was a fake rhino horn and no direct recovery has been made from the accused petitioner.

However, considering the length of detention of the accused petitioner in judicial custody for 60 days, this Court is of the opinion that in the interest of investigation, further continuation of detention is not warranted.
This disposes of the bail application.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, it is provided that the accused petitioner, named above shall be released on bail of Rs.
40,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned SDJM, Kaliabor, Nagaon subject to the following conditions- :
(I) That the accused petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer as and when required;
(II) That the accused petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Police Officer or the Court;
(III) That the accused petitioner shall refrain from committing any such offence of which he is accused of commission.
This disposes of the bail application.
